knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The booking must be moved so the full processing time, set-up and clean-down are allowed. The label time is not shortened.
A health-related cancellation is a referral decision under the consultation procedure, recorded with the reason, not a no-show.
The lesson says to use the lone-worker check-in for each visit and to record the time the operator arrives and leaves.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks that a sample booking includes set-up, consultation, processing, clean-down and travel time
Assessor observes the candidate complete a lone-worker check-in on arrival and on departure at a simulated visit
Assessor checks that a simulated cancellation is recorded with notice given, reason and decision
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample booking record with the time breakdown
Check-in times for the simulated visit
Cancellation record with notice, reason and decision
stopWorkCriteria: A booking is confirmed with a processing time shorter than the label time
A visit starts with no check-in method in place
A client's address is unsafe and the candidate enters without contacting the escalation contact
